checkpoint.title: Pewter: the Running Shoes from Oak's aide

events.why: out of the Gym, east along row 21, short of the top trigger
"Oh, PLAYER!" ... the Running Shoes; ends facing north
west along row 21 and down to below the Pokemon Center's door (17, 25)

checkpoint: At the rows after Brock: no items counted, the starter with the moves the story gave it by Lv13. A run that loads a save reads the moves off the lead's summary instead (read_lead_moves()), so a save whose moves differ from these (console B, 2026-11-02: Water Gun where Tackle was) is fought with the moves it has.
before_aide_trigger: Brock's win sets VAR_MAP_SCENE_PEWTER_CITY to 1 and shows the aide at (46, 20); his triggers are (46, 21..23) (PewterCity map.json). The Gym guide's triggers at (42..43, 21..23) need the scene at 0.
shoes_from_aide: RunningShoesAideTriggerTop: the aide talks from (46, 20), no YES/NO; the player only turns up. He walks off and is removed; FLAG_SYS_B_DASH is set (console B, 2026-11-02: about 20 B presses to the overworld).
below_pewter_center: Where the by-hand walk stopped to start 04.01 (console B, 2026-11-02).
